name: Bizoforce

sources.title: Homepage — B2B marketplace for 'AI & digital solutions' vendors; vendor CTAs: 'Submit Company — Free listing', 'Add Product — SaaS & software', 'Submit AI Agent'; directory organized by specializations (AI 688+ cos, Cyber Security 265+, Blockchain 307+)
Submit Company route — JS-rendered, returns empty shell to non-JS fetch; labeled 'Free listing' on homepage
Add Product route — JS-rendered empty shell; for SaaS & software products

requirements: B2B vendor fit — the directory is for companies selling AI, cloud, DevOps, CRM, analytics, security and other digital-transformation solutions; consumer apps have no fit
Three submit paths exist: company listing (free), product listing (SaaS/software), AI-agent listing
Site runs its own 'SUGAR Quadrant' ranking/verification — a bare listing exists, but verified/vendor-scored placement may involve more
preparation: Company name, website, description, and the specialization category that fits (AI, cloud, cybersecurity, blockchain, DevOps, VR, big data, etc.)
For product listings: product name, description, URL
Company profile details likely include size, location, services — prepare standard vendor-profile copy
workflow: Pick the right route: /submit/listing (company) or /submit/product (product) or /submit/ai-agent
Open the submit page in a JS-capable browser — forms do not render without JavaScript
Complete the listing form and submit
Verify the company appears under /business-directory in the chosen specialization
watchFor: Submit pages are client-rendered — nothing can be inspected without JavaScript
Homepage heavily markets its own product suite (Screenly, Giglancer, Work CRM) — the directory is a lead-gen layer for their ecosystem; expect outreach/sales contact after listing
'Verified Solution Providers' and SUGAR Quadrant placement likely gate visibility behind a vetting or commercial process
URLs still carry legacy 'bizofit' slugs — the platform rebranded from Bizofit
countsAsLive: The company/product appears in the Bizoforce business directory under a specialization page and is searchable
unknowns: Exact form fields and any account requirement (pages are JS-rendered)
Review/vetting process before a listing is public
Whether 'Free listing' placement is meaningfully visible vs paid/verified placements
